# Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `npm run lint` in `apps/web`, if app code changed
- [ ] Ran `npm run build` in `apps/web`, if app code changed
- [ ] Checked the affected route or demo path manually
- [ ] Updated judge/sponsor docs if evidence changed

## Security Check

- [ ] No API keys, wallet secrets, Snowflake credentials, or `.env.local` files are included
- [ ] New environment variables are added to `apps/web/.env.example`
- [ ] API route changes include validation or safe error handling

## Notes

Add deployment notes, screenshots, route links, or sponsor evidence details.
